color-canvas: Window background behind the navigation and the work area; Fluent and Console also paint the title bar with it. Every skin keeps it off pure black and white.
color-surface: Primary work surface: the classic navigation pane and section blocks, control fills, Fluent cards, Console panels and Cupertino groups.
color-surface-subtle: Hover and selected rows, the selected segment, secondary fills and code wells. Console light makes it its brightest surface and fills controls with it.
color-foreground: Primary text and icons on color-canvas, color-surface and color-surface-subtle.
color-muted: Secondary text (descriptions, metadata, key/value labels, inactive navigation icons) on color-canvas, color-surface and color-surface-subtle.
color-border: Hairline separators and the edges of sections, panels and groups. Fluent and Cupertino use a translucent ink so the hairline follows the surface under it.
color-border-strong: Control edges (buttons, fields, the switch track, segmented controls, step circles) and scrollbar thumbs.
color-primary: The one accent: selection markers, the filled primary action, checked switches and text actions. It is never body text on color-canvas.
color-on-primary: Text, glyphs and switch thumbs on a color-primary fill.
color-focus: The 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px, on every focusable control.
color-success: Verified and running state only: status bands, status dots and state text. Never decorative.
color-warning: Attention state only: the status band edge, warning text and notices. Never decorative.
color-destructive: Failure and destructive actions: danger buttons, critical rows, error dots and the window close button's hover fill (with a white glyph).
color-preview: Ground of the preview canvas, profile thumbnails and specimen strips when the canvas follows the window theme. Helper bitmaps own their own colours on top of it.
space-1: 4px: gaps inside the navigation lists and between a heading and its description.
space-2: 8px: icon-to-label gaps, navigation item padding and the gap between header actions.
space-3: 12px: button side padding, navigation pane side padding and setting-row rhythm.
space-4: 16px: section heading and detail row padding, and the navigation pane's top padding.
space-5: 20px: the gap between navigation blocks and the Tuner's vertical padding.
space-6: 24px: page header bottom padding and the Tuner's side padding.
space-8: 32px: page padding and the gap between sections.
space-10: 40px: the largest step of the grid; declared for major regions and currently unused by the stylesheets.
radius-control: Corners of controls, navigation items, status bands and preview canvases.
nav-width: Width of the navigation column: classic 220px, Fluent 248px, Console's icon rail 64px, Cupertino 224px.
titlebar-height: Height of the custom window title bar: 40px in every skin but Console (32px).
control-height: Minimum height of buttons, icon buttons, fields and selects: classic 40px, Fluent 32px, Console and Cupertino 26px. The classic Tuner page sets 28px.
switch-width: Switch track width: 40px classic and Fluent, 30px Console, 26px Cupertino.
switch-height: Switch track height: 20px classic and Fluent, 16px Console, 15px Cupertino.
switch-inset: Gap between the thumb and the track edge: 3px, Console and Cupertino 1px. The shared primitive derives both thumb positions from it in LTR and RTL.
selection-size: Side of a native checkbox or radio square: 16px, Console 14px. The square never shrinks.
select-marker-inset: Distance of the closed select chevron from the trailing edge: 8px, Cupertino 7px.
select-badge-size: Accent badge behind the select chevron: 0px everywhere except Cupertino's 16px.
settings-index-width: Width of the Tuner's step index column: classic 196px, Fluent 168px, Cupertino 184px.
settings-control-width: Stable control column of a setting row: classic 232px, Fluent and Console 220px, Cupertino 200px.
opacity-disabled: Opacity of a disabled button or switch and of its state label.
shadow-window: Layers that float above the window: the preference menu, hint popovers and modal dialogs. Never on in-window sections or cards.
fluent-text-3: Fluent's third text level: the dim breadcrumb before a page title and its chevron.
fluent-hover: Fluent hover fill for navigation items, index rows and preference rows.
fluent-selected: Fluent selected-row fill, paired with the 3x16 accent pill.
fluent-divider: Fluent divider above the navigation footer and between an expander card and its sub-rows.
fluent-control-bottom: Fluent control bottom edge: the darker line that replaces a shadow under buttons and fields.
fluent-accent-bottom: Bottom edge of the filled Fluent primary button.
fluent-accent-text: Fluent text actions and links, and the hover label of the designate button.
fluent-accent-soft: Fluent accent tint behind a pressed event filter chip.
fluent-success-soft: Fluent tint behind a completed step number in the Tuner index.
fluent-thumb: Fluent ground of a profile card's 64px thumbnail.
console-text-3: Console's third text level: breadcrumb chevrons, log timestamps and field placeholders.
console-accent-soft: Console accent tint: the designate button, a ghost button's hover and the selected segment.
console-ok-soft: Console tint behind an ok tag.
console-warn-soft: Console tint for a warning tag; declared beside console-ok-soft and currently unused by the stylesheet.
console-bad-soft: Console tint for a failure tag; declared beside console-ok-soft and currently unused by the stylesheet.
cupertino-side: Cupertino sidebar ground, which runs to the top edge of the window.
cupertino-text-3: Cupertino's third text level: disclosure chevrons and the search field placeholder.
cupertino-sep: Cupertino hairline between rows, inset 16px past the leading slot.
cupertino-track: Cupertino switch track while off, and the ground of a step number.
cupertino-accent-soft: Cupertino accent tint behind badges and selected list or profile rows.
cupertino-search: Cupertino search field fill and the sidebar item hover.
cupertino-tile-gray: Desaturated sidebar tile and the neutral status circle.
